t: A high school drone course where students build and program an autonomous quadrotor.
steps: Find the DuckieSky page at Brown and the Duckietown Drone Academy page.
Ask the program how to get kits and teacher training.
Confirm the current ordering steps, which were not found.
Gather a drone kit with a Raspberry Pi and camera.
Ask about the privacy and data terms.
Consider the one-week summer academy as an option.
